collections.retentionReason: These authored scene layouts are canonical source, not generated playback ledgers; no complete generator replaces them.
collections.compactAlternativeInsufficient: A receipt cannot reconstruct the authored per-element scene geometry and navigation.

collections.retentionReason: The explicitly separate iOS packaging workflow retains its current development snapshot; this web-runtime migration does not regenerate or alter that package.
collections.compactAlternativeInsufficient: An iOS source/package migration requires its own strict package and device checks; routine web setup must not silently build it.

collections.regenerationCommand: No single byte-identical regeneration command: use the per-run commands, original inputs and source identities retained in the linked recovery analyses and evidence receipts. Historical observations must not be regenerated and relabeled as originals.
collections.retentionReason: Operator-approved collection-specific 125000-line ceiling on 2026-09-08 for active recovery and Option B verification. At approval review the collection measured 193 machine files, 100540 lines and 5163492 bytes. Preserve compact source-recovery, independent-review, execution and Option B verification records required by the named consumers; provide bounded headroom for continued verification. The 10485760-byte limit and general individual-file, collection and branch limits remain unchanged.
collections.compactAlternativeInsufficient: A summary alone would omit the source identities, detailed review bindings and negative-control records used by current recovery and Option B analyses. Keep new receipts compact and tied to current consumers; no independently verified replacement for the retained evidence collection has been established. Review consolidation when its consumers retire. Growth reaching either collection ceiling requires a new explicit storage decision.
